adminOnly: Only the community's admins can import.

section.title: Import
section.description: Bring records over from another program's exports, or back from spreadsheets Hoard exported.

stocksmith.title: Import from Stocksmith
stocksmith.description: Bring your catalogue over from Stocksmith's CSV exports: materials, bases, products and their recipes, with suppliers, categories and bins. Hoard checks the files first, and makes only what it doesn't have yet.
stocksmith.countsNote: What's already in Hoard is left as it is.

files.recipesHint: Optional. Every item its lines name must be in the materials export or already in Hoard.
files.manufacturesHint: Optional. Read to tell products from bases, and which bases Stocksmith made when a run was short: no runs are imported.

spreadsheets.title: Import Hoard spreadsheets
spreadsheets.description: Bring back the catalogue spreadsheets exported from Reports › Export, once you've edited them. A row with an id changes that record, and a row without one is matched by its name, or a variation by its SKU, or else added. An empty cell clears its field, a column you leave out is left as it is, and nothing is deleted: archive a record by setting its status. A {{recipe}} in the file is replaced by its rows. Stock, lots and costs change only through runs, purchases and adjustments.
spreadsheets.countsNote: Records the files don't hold are left as they are.

files.productsHint: Optional. products.csv: a row per variation.
files.recipesHint: Optional. recipes.csv: a row per line.

stock.label: Bring stock on hand, dated
stock.hint: Each material's stock on hand starts at the main location on this day, at its actual unit cost, wherever it holds none there yet.

problems.title: Fix these first, then check again
problems.none: No problems found: the files are ready to import.

codes.COLUMN_MISSING: This isn't the file it was chosen as: it has no “{{name}}” column.
codes.COLUMN_UNKNOWN: Hoard doesn't know the column “{{name}}”. Name it as the export does, or take it out.
codes.COSTS_HIDDEN: Only members who can see costs can import the column “{{name}}”. Take it out.
codes.FILE_UNREADABLE: This file can't be read as CSV.
codes.ID_UNKNOWN: “{{name}}” isn't the id of one of this community's records of this kind.
codes.ROW_REPEATED: Another row is for the same record. Keep one of them.
codes.SKU_REPEATED: The SKU “{{name}}” would be on two variations.
codes.NAME_AMBIGUOUS: More than one record is called “{{name}}”. Give the row its id to say which.
codes.VALUE_INVALID: “{{name}}” isn't a value this column takes.
codes.NUMBER_INVALID: “{{name}}” isn't a number. Write it without thousands separators.
codes.NUMBER_OUT_OF_RANGE: {{name}} is out of range for this column.
codes.TYPE_UNKNOWN: Hoard has no type called “{{name}}”. Add it in Settings › Types.
codes.UNIT_UNKNOWN: Hoard doesn't know the unit “{{name}}”. Add it in Settings › Units.
codes.OPTION_UNKNOWN: “{{name}}” isn't one of this property's options.
codes.OPTIONS_INVALID: Write options as “Size: Large; Tin: Red”.
codes.COLUMNS_DISAGREE: This row differs from the first row of the same record. Make them the same.
codes.RECIPE_OUTPUT_UNKNOWN: “{{name}}” isn't a base or a product's variation, in the files or in Hoard.
codes.RECIPE_OUTPUT_DIFFERS: This id is for a {{recipe}} that makes something other than “{{name}}”.
codes.LINE_NAMES_NOTHING: “{{name}}” isn't a material, base or product in the files or in Hoard.
codes.LINE_REPEATED: This recipe names “{{name}}” on two lines.
codes.RECIPE_REPEATED: A second recipe for “{{name}}”. Delete one of them from the file.
codes.RECIPE_CONTAINS_ITSELF: The recipe for “{{name}}” would contain itself.

done.title: Imported
done.nothing: Everything in the files was in Hoard already.

errors.IMPORT_ADMIN_ONLY: Only the community's admins can import.
errors.IMPORT_FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is too large to import.
errors.IMPORT_OPTIONS_INVALID: Choose the day the stock is dated.
errors.IMPORT_PROBLEMS: The files have problems. Check them again and fix what's listed.
errors.UNIT_UNKNOWN: A unit the files name isn't in Hoard any more. Check the files again.
